final: WITH ok AS (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), pp AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.ALP * 1.0 / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM ok) GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(pp.avg_pt) AS avg_pt_per_patient, AVG(pp.avg_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_per_patient FROM pp JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = pp.ID GROUP BY p.SEX
